scope: Declared contribution tasks, response/baseline/context bias and full-PV resource contracts; no default material-price or strength promotion

declaration.question: Does whole-state signed ordinary-entity control distinguish base continuation at a preselected paired first-transfer frontier?
declaration.population: First frontier in ascending seed order, not result-selected. Qualified counterfactual G/TP roots, historical reachability unproved.
declaration.policy: Both players uniform over every legal action, canonical sorted serialized action. Shared pseudorandom uniforms across base cases provide paired sampling, not equal actions after action sets diverge. Seeds2026100806+i for32 trajectories.
declaration.utility: Owner0 ordinary board-plus-hand entity count minus owner1 count. Report terminal control minus initial control, no extra WDL payoff. Shogi ordinary capture transfers control for +/-2; drops/promotions change0. This is a declared unit task, never positive material prices or tagged-only service.
declaration.cost: 32 paired trajectories,64 plies maximum4096 continuation transitions, serial; persist every trial; stop flags per trial. Outcome changes whether to examine finite whole-state contribution or reject this uniform policy as too weak/noisy, not a success threshold selected after results.

native_oracle.declaration: All64 observed whole-state paths replay through guarded Native actions from exact full-history roots. Compare Native unit control snapshots at8/16/32/64 and full final board/hands/side/terminal with recorded Core state. Different kernels; no Core continuation reused. Qualifies these trajectories, not MC population accuracy or material prices.

dilution.declaration: Exact1/2-ply uniform legal-action expected ordinary-control delta at all13 existing paired first-transfer frontiers. Counterfactual/exposed population, not universal ordering. Replay full history, compare root action identities and second-ply ordinary capture signatures. A capture numerator shared across cases but differing legal counts identifies action-normalization dilution; retain every reply and Native/Core legal-set checks. No longer horizon, model fitting, TT/evaluator change or WDL utility.
dilution.initial_classification_failure: Initial root categorization treated drops as other board moves; corrected category means replace them. Both versions retained; zero paired contrasts unchanged.

whole_minimax.declaration: First paired first-transfer frontier by seed, same as uniform control pilot. Full Native legality/history, owner0 max/owner1 min ordinary board-plus-hand control at2/3/4plies. Actual terminal stops with existing control utility, NO WDL/mate bonus. Simple diagnostic alpha-beta, no TT, qsearch or unknown prices. Ordinary captures ordered before other lexical public actions. Equal20000visited-node/60sec cost checkpoint per case/depth, incomplete unknown. Earlier exact2ply policy-control is independent expected reference. Outcome distinguishes finite adversarial contribution from uniform action dilution; no result-driven extension or positive stock-price inference.

whole_core_reference.declaration: Independent Core legal transitions, immutable full-history states and reverse lexical action order. Same ordinary-control terminal/leaf payoff, no Native/TT or product WDL utility. First frontier,2/3/4ply references with20000nodes/15sec per case/depth cost checkpoint. Incomplete means unknown, not validation failure/pass. Resources differ from Native and are reported; no speed ratio on incomplete cells.
whole_core_reference.timing_scope: Core reference overlapped the default test run; unknown cells remain unknown and timing is not an isolated speed comparison.

conditional_spectrum.declaration: New conditional-action question, not extension of the frozen optimal-score test. At the same first frontier compare every matched owner0 root action under3 subsequent adversarial plies (total4), full unit-control utility/history and no WDL bonus. Each action gets an independent full alpha/beta window, no root-bound reuse. Equal200000node/60sec aggregate checkpoint per base; unknown actions retained on fuse. Difference can reveal a base continuation effect hidden by equal maxima; equality localizes this task/horizon failure, not all mechanisms. Expected incremental Native work tens of thousands of transitions and seconds, serial/interruptible, no labels.

ability.declaration: New counterfactual task, not rescue of prior signed reward normalization. Same ordered4x4 source/activeenemy/passiveenemy population3360 per16 primitive mode pairs. Both sides may always pass; own baseline actor may only pass but remains occupied/capturable. Ability variant may pass or use its ordinary geometric moves. Reward enemy entity removal+1 and actor loss-1, no anchors/hands/promotions. Compare V(ability)-V(immobile) at2/4plies both initial phases under minimax. Backward strategy inclusion predicts nonnegative premium at every root; positivity is an option premium for this artificial pass task, not stock/material prices. No pawn scaling, human-price fitting or legal-game claim.
ability.interpretation: At a matched context the immobile baseline cancels in actor-to-actor differences. It changes the reference and ratios; nonnegative option premium alone does not calibrate stock prices.

partial_pawn.declaration: New counterfactual task, not rescue of prior signed reward normalization. Pawn-specific development extension: ordered4x4 source/activeenemy/passiveenemy population3360 per4 opponent modes. Owner0 partial pawn has one-square empty forward move and enemy-only diagonal capture, always-forward rank; no double move, en-passant or promotion. Includes immobile last-rank roots. No reference labels enter the construction. Both sides may always pass; own baseline actor may only pass but remains occupied/capturable. Ability variant may pass or use its ordinary geometric moves. Reward enemy entity removal+1 and actor loss-1, no anchors/hands/promotions. Compare V(ability)-V(immobile) at2/4plies both initial phases under minimax. Backward strategy inclusion predicts nonnegative premium at every root; positivity is an option premium for this artificial pass task, not stock/material prices. No pawn scaling, human-price fitting or legal-game claim.

record_cadence.declaration: Serialization/I/O development microbenchmark, NOT a scientific rerun or cost estimate. Use the first64 observed contexts of each8pair as a representative growing JSON payload. Existing atomic write_record, same final bytes, per-root versus per16-root checkpoints, both two repeats alternating order. Count exact encoded UTF8 bytes written, calls and encode+write wall time. Initial/final checkpoints retained, no new format/helper. Output payloads are ignored benchmark files, not new science records. Decision: bounded batch persistence for future bulk producers rather than global durability changes.
record_cadence.timing_scope: Includes byte-count encoding/checks and atomic writer. A bounded overhead comparison, not production speed or measured total bytes of the earlier512-context producer.
